headline: Senate races through nominations and Iran resolutions as child care rule faces congressional pushback!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate passed a resolution opposing any presidential pardon or clemency for Ghislaine Maxwell and designated July as National Anti-Counterfeiting and Consumer Education and Awareness Month. The chamber began consideration of H.R. 5334, the SEED Act, which would expand educator expense deductions for early childhood educators, passing a motion to proceed 84-12.
